title: Broken object-level authorization through a user-controlled TypeScript key
preconditions: route/body/query identifier selects a database object
tenant or owner identity is available separately from the selected key
dangerous_transitions: user-controlled object key reaches a lookup or mutation without principal/object comparison
sink_semantics: filesystem/object-store keys and cache entries selected by request parameters
counterevidence: The query is scoped by the authenticated principal/tenant or an equivalent policy is checked before use.
verification_recipe: Trace request-controlled identifiers to reads and writes, including batch and nested routes.
Compare owner, same-tenant, and cross-tenant access outcomes.
